post.description: Records one customer-requested fiat account and answers 202 with the operation that tracks it. Admits a customer token carrying a fresh iat, a Confirmation-Intent-ID naming the confirmed intent for this action, and an Idempotency-Key. The confirmation action is account.create and binds to the complete normalized request body. An accepted operation can submit provisioning at most once, and only after its durable record is committed. If submission begins but no definitive result is saved, read-only reconciliation looks for exactly one matching account in the requested currency and the write is never resubmitted automatically. Acceptance states no eligibility for another customer or currency. The Idempotency-Key header binds for at least the replay window published by GET /v1/identity. Inside that guaranteed window an equal replay returns the same operation with Idempotent-Replayed set to true. A client with an unresolved response must stop before the window ends and reconcile operation history rather than retry later. A transport-uncertain write leaves the operation indeterminate and is never repeated.

post.description: Records the one customer-instructed money movement offered here and answers 202 with the operation that tracks it. Admits a customer token carrying a fresh iat, a Confirmation-Intent-ID naming the confirmed intent for this action, and an Idempotency-Key. The beneficiary and every amount come from the named quote rather than from this request body, so a stale quote is refused rather than repriced. The operation opens in requires_action carrying a hosted approval hand-off on the trusted Perflo application origin; the client sends the browser there and then polls the same operation. The Idempotency-Key header binds for at least the replay window published by GET /v1/identity. Inside that guaranteed window an equal replay returns the same operation with Idempotent-Replayed set to true. A client with an unresolved response must stop before the window ends and reconcile operation history rather than retry later. A transport-uncertain write leaves the operation indeterminate and is never repeated.
